meta.name: Kabisa Admin
meta.description: A quantified Redseer-inspired operational admin interface, themed with exact Kabisa teal tokens.
source_references: Kabisa Admin Panel Full Build Spec section 4
Written Redseer admin reference description; screenshot not attached
UI/UX Pro Max healthcare and data-dashboard guidance

color.palette_type: analogous teal with restrained semantic accents

primary.role: AA-compliant primary actions, active navigation, and emphasized controls

secondary.role: near-black sidebar anchor with a subtle teal undertone

accent.role: logo-true accent, focus ring, links on dark, and charts

neutral.usage: Warm near-white workspace, white cards, hairline borders, charcoal primary copy

color.contrast_strategy: Dark-on-light dominant with deep teal actions; true brand teal is reserved for accents because it is too light for small white button text

typography.font_style_notes: Editorial, trustworthy Fraunces headings paired with neutral, high-legibility Inter operational UI and tabular monospaced codes

spacing.section_rhythm: 24px between page regions, 16px within cards, 52–60px table rows

layout.grid_system: fixed 260px sidebar plus fluid twelve-column main workspace
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with left-aligned content and right-aligned actions/numerics

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px borders on cards, controls, tables, and outlined row actions

elevation.depth_cues: borders first, soft shadows second, dark sidebar contrast as the primary anchor

motion.entrance_pattern: 8–16px directional translate plus opacity with decelerating landing
motion.exit_pattern: shorter directional translate plus opacity with accelerating departure
motion.philosophy: minimal functional corporate/calm motion that confirms state and spatial relationships

components.button_style: 10px-radius deep-teal primary buttons; white bordered secondary buttons; compact outlined pill row actions
components.input_style: 42px minimum height, visible label, pale surface, subtle border, and 3px true-teal focus halo
components.card_style: white 14px-radius bordered surfaces with minimal layered shadow
components.navigation_pattern: fixed near-black grouped sidebar with solid deep-teal active pill and pinned user profile
components.modal_style: right-side drawer or centered dialog with focus trap, labelled close, soft high elevation, and restrained slide/fade
components.list_style: serif page header, bordered filters, selection-aware bulk row, selectable data table, status pills, pagination
components.component_notes: All actions use verbs; status includes text; numeric cells are tabular; empty and error language stays calm and direct

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A well-organized pharmacy operations ledger inside a quiet executive workspace
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary 2026 enterprise software with restrained editorial typography
aesthetic.genre: healthcare operations SaaS with executive analytics

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous around page regions, efficient inside data components
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: dark sidebar anchor balanced by light main workspace and compact teal actions
visual_language.focal_strategy: typographic hierarchy and isolated primary action
visual_language.contrast_level: high for navigation and text, moderate for borders and secondary surfaces
visual_language.texture_usage: none; flat warm surfaces and precise hairlines

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic scale, spatial isolation, and controlled teal color weight
composition.balance_type: asymmetric shell with a stable left anchor
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom page workflow and left-to-right table scanning
composition.grouping_strategy: proximity inside bordered regions with repeated list-page sequencing
composition.negative_space_role: separates decision zones and reduces cognitive load around dense tables

imagery.photo_treatment: small, natural product thumbnails on neutral white backgrounds only
imagery.illustration_style: minimal line illustration reserved for empty states
imagery.graphic_elements: status dots, thin dividers, tiny trend lines, and teal chart strokes
imagery.image_shape: 10–12px rounded rectangles or circles for avatars

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate, quiet, and explicit through labels, toasts, and status change
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: stable color, border, and shadow changes without layout shift
interaction_feel.loading_style: low-contrast skeletons; small verification Lottie is deferred to the verification workflow
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: very low and limited to comprehension or confirmation

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative verbs such as Create order, Apply filters, and Review customer
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state what is absent, why it matters, and the single next action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: specific and calm, preserving user input and offering recovery

overview.fallback_strategy: disable spatial transforms and use short opacity feedback when prefers-reduced-motion is set
overview.primary_technology: CSS transitions plus Motion for component presence; Lottie only for a later small success state

background_effects.description: Flat warm-neutral application background with no decorative animation

particle_systems.description: Particle systems are explicitly forbidden in the admin

3d_elements.description: Three-dimensional elements are reserved for the customer storefront

shader_effects.description: Shader effects would conflict with operational clarity and performance goals

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll morphing in the admin

cursor_effects.description: Use the platform cursor with pointer state on interactive elements

image_effects.description: Product and avatar images use stable crops without decorative distortion

params.reveal_animation: short opacity transition only when lazy-loaded

canvas_drawings.description: Charts in later phases use accessible SVG or DOM libraries with tabular alternatives

svg_animations.description: Lucide SVG icons are static except for standard CSS state transitions

visual_effects.composite_notes: The admin deliberately disables decorative advanced effects. Motion is limited to focus shifts, drawers, row changes, KPI count feedback, toasts, and later a small verification-success Lottie. Every spatial animation has a reduced-motion opacity or static fallback.
